caption:
Austin’s housing plan update gets the go-ahead.

A follow-up to our October committee coverage: on November 5, Austin City Council approved Item 26 as amended, directing the City Manager to update the Strategic Housing Blueprint.

The listed scope includes updated housing production and preservation goals, data analysis, displacement strategies, stakeholder engagement and consideration of a potential bond program.

Why it matters for Austin housing: the work will revisit goals for adding homes, keeping existing housing and addressing displacement. The resulting recommendations could help shape future housing priorities and funding discussions.

Council authorized work on the update; it has not adopted a finished replacement plan. The action itself does not approve a bond election or new homes.

Next to watch: the revised goals, staff recommendations and subsequent Council decisions.

Source: City of Austin, November 5, 2026 Council action notes, Item 26 (marked approved as amended; action notes are preliminary).
